claim: Patchline ships a mechanistic study explaining which corpus features drive each learned decision. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the mechanistic claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make mechanistic-feature-study-gate`.
